Because the zephyr derivation is checked against the crystal nonce, the velvet audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 16 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
